mathematical_review_extent: Cartan–Hadamard source is universal Riemannian cover with complete pulled-back metric; Jacobi angular differential gives sinh²r polar metric; Pauli action realizes full PSL2(C), SO3 stabilizer and free discrete torsion-free deck group.

Small-matrix commutator estimate yields uniform vanishing of generator commutators; last nonzero commutators form a central subgroup and induction proves nilpotence. Compact-K finite cover and conjugated repeated-prefix block deletion produce finite coset representatives, not just small generated nilpotent subgroup.

Finite-index normal core is nontrivial when D is infinite, nilpotent and centrally contained in one parabolic/diagonal centralizer. Normality forces D elementary; torsion-freeness excludes pair swaps and rotations.

Horoball/tube displacement formulas and finite powers supply all thin models. Thick-set disjoint embedded-ball packing gives compactness; bounded displacement sets are compact in the frame group, proving local finiteness and finite components. Rank-one horocusps have infinite transverse volume and are excluded.

Full peripheral recognition uses properly embedded rank-two horocusps and supplied compact cores in both directions. Lattice isomorphisms extend to affine horizontal invertible maps preserving depth. Locally finite weighted future-timelike sums construct smooth equivariant core maps; compact quotient derivatives, inverse affine cusps and bounded composites prove global QI and proper homotopy equivalence.

Explicit model slimness, Morse line control and ideal triangle centers yield uniform all-circle boundary distortion after Möbius normalization. This is stronger than a Hölder estimate. Difference-quotient area estimate proves W12 without assuming null preservation; actual independent total differentiability interface plus rank-one exclusion gives the precise analytic H bound.

Frame-fiber measure is both-sided Haar because real detAd=1; quotient mass is exactly finite positive hyperbolic volume. Lifted Beltrami tensor defines bounded L2 function on finite Haar quotient. Strongly continuous unitary right action, diagonal contraction of both unipotent subgroups, their explicit generation of PSL2(C), and product Fubini show invariant functions constant. Rotation weight forces that constant zero, proving conformality/Möbius.

Orientation reversal handled by reflection conjugacy. Full centralizer proof includes elliptic involutions and orientation-reversing fixed-plane/fixed-point possibilities; elementary and Fuchsian groups have infinite3volume. Proper arbitrary-equivalence homotopy is controlled inside arbitrarily deep convex cusp horoballs, with compact remaining core. Orientation degree and volume density change of variables give final clauses.
